title: Hakeem Jeffries criticizes GOP over cost of living and government shutdown in new posts
text:
Hakeem Jeffries, U.S. Congressman representing New York’s 8th district since 2013, used his social media platform on November 5, 2025, to criticize former President Donald Trump and Republican lawmakers regarding the cost of living and recent political developments.
In a post published at 01:04 UTC, Jeffries stated: “America is too expensive.
Donald Trump and Republicans haven’t done a damn thing to lower the high cost of living.
And working class Americans know it.”
Later that day, at 12:54 UTC, he commented on a meeting involving Trump and Republican officials at the White House: “Donald Trump and Republicans are meeting at the White House this morning.
The extremists want to make your life more expensive, take away healthcare and keep the government shut down.
Have they learned nothing from being wiped out last night?
#BlueWave”
A third post appeared at 21:01 UTC containing only a link: https://t.co/T6yeEEGxCi.
Jeffries has served in Congress since replacing Edolphus Towns in 2013 and previously held office in the New York State Assembly from 2007 to 2012. Born in Brooklyn in 1970, he continues to reside there. His academic background includes a BA from Binghamton University (1992) and a JD from New York University (1997).
